The commercial requirement

Vehicle care built around the work.

Mechanical repairs and bodywork may leave a vehicle needing a considered final presentation before customer collection. Dust, fingerprints, residue and existing cabin dirt can distract from otherwise high-quality workshop work.

Auto Opulence can support the finishing stage with interior and exterior valeting, paint assessment and machine polishing. Garages, bodyshops and mobile specialists can also hire the indoor bay when they need professional lighting, washing, drainage or more working space for a particular vehicle.

  • Post-work vehicle presentation
  • Interior and exterior valeting
  • Paint refinement options
  • Short, full-day and overnight trade bay hire
01

Post-work presentation

A careful final clean helps the repaired or serviced vehicle feel properly prepared when it is returned to the customer.

02

Paint finish assessment

Professional lighting supports inspection of polishing haze, light swirls and finish quality before additional refinement is agreed.

03

Occasional extra capacity

Trade bay hire provides a purpose-equipped indoor workspace without the business maintaining a dedicated detailing area for occasional jobs.

A clear working process

From requirement to handover.

Every enquiry starts with the vehicles, the operating requirement and the result your business needs.

  1. 01

    Explain the workshop task

    Tell us what has been completed, the remaining presentation requirement and whether Auto Opulence or your own team will carry out the work.

  2. 02

    Choose service or hire

    Select a completed valeting or polishing service, or reserve the trade bay and equipment for your own technician.

  3. 03

    Confirm access and timing

    The working window, vehicle size, equipment requirement and collection time are agreed before arrival.

  4. 04

    Prepare for handover

    The vehicle is checked against the agreed presentation objective before it returns to your workshop or customer.

Explore the equipment

Relevant completed project

BMW E21 3 Series Restoration Detail

This factory-original BMW E21 3 Series arrived with its original paint, glass, matching numbers and original dealer-supplied number plates. Although the 45-year-old car had clearly been cared for, decades of use had dulled its red paintwork and marked the light interior. Over 18 focused hours, Auto Opulence deep-cleaned the cabin, corrected the paint, detailed the engine bay and applied Gyeon ceramic protection while respecting the car's originality.

This genuine Auto Opulence project demonstrates vehicle-care processes that can also be relevant when planning work for garages & bodyshops. It is not presented as a claim that the customer belonged to this business sector.

Garages & Bodyshops FAQs

Planning the work.

Can you valet a vehicle after garage or bodyshop work?

Yes. We can discuss a suitable interior, exterior or complete-valet route based on the work completed and the handover standard required.

Can our own technician hire the detailing bay?

Yes. Trade users can hire the indoor bay for three hours, a full day, or a full day with overnight access, subject to availability and hire requirements.

What equipment is included with trade bay hire?

The bay provides indoor working space, drainage, professional lighting, a Kranzle K7 pressure washer and spotless water. Selected longer sessions also include access to extraction and detailing equipment; confirm the exact requirement before booking.

Can you refine paint after repair work?

Paint enhancement can be considered after inspection. We need to understand the repair, paint condition and required outcome before recommending Stage 1 or multi-stage polishing.

What time must an overnight vehicle be collected?

Full-day trade and overnight hire requires collection by 8:30am the following morning unless another arrangement has been expressly confirmed.
